verdict.rationale: Figma publishes a documented REST API with endpoints for reading/writing file objects, webhooks, and usage data, plus a Plugin API supporting read/write access, and an official MCP server (both remote hosted and local) confirmed live via runtime probes and OAuth-compliant. This gives AI-native users multiple documented, verified programmatic surfaces to drive the product. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (404s on probe) and no independent third-party corroboration beyond Figma's own docs/GitHub.
